manifest.analysis: Gaussian expected Fisher information, asymptotic theoretical benchmark

calibration_check.interpretation: Exploratory calibration concern: Wilson narrowly excludes5%, exact equal-tailed interval includes5%; no proof of miscalibration or certified remedy. The multiplicity calculation illustrates adjustment across two original null conditions, not all analyses.

manifest.motivation: Exploratory follow-up to original negative-null 23/300 rejection; Wilson and exact intervals differ at nominal .05. This follow-up protocol is prospective, not a claim of original-study preregistration.
manifest.primary_estimand: Null rejection probability of the 999-resample percentile interval at nominal alpha .05.
manifest.secondary_estimand: Paired B999 minus first-B399 rejection difference on the same fresh outer surveys.
manifest.stopping_rule: Exactly 1000 independent outer surveys; no outcome-dependent early stopping or sample-size extension.
manifest.intervals: Pointwise 95% Wilson and exact Clopper-Pearson rates; paired empirical-bootstrap difference interval from 20000 multinomial resamples.
manifest.failure_rule: Failed outer tests count as non-rejections in all-attempt denominators. Inner failures retain positions; a prefix needs at least95% valid refits. Report all failures, improper fits and nonconvergence.
manifest.diagnostic_optimization: Suppress unused fit indices only inside resamples; all measurement and structural estimation remains the public fit function.

primary_distribution_migration.change: Remove SciPy dependency for reference distributions; estimator, seeds, draws and test decisions unchanged.
primary_distribution_migration.source_semantics: Current manifest describes rerunnable equivalent implementation; preserved execution_sources and original manifest document pre-migration implementation.

bootstrap_distribution_migration.change: Remove SciPy dependency for reference distributions; estimator, seeds, draws and test decisions unchanged.

assumptions.test: two-sided, nominal alpha .05; no multiplicity adjustment
assumptions.calibration: 95th percentile of absolute naive z over independent null draws, numpy quantile(method='higher')
assumptions.failures: all-attempt rejection denominators; failed/nonfinite fits count as non-rejections; conditional rates separately labeled

interpretation.main: Independent null-calibration, held-out-null, and alternative simulations. Naive rejection under the alternative is not calibrated power.
interpretation.calibrated: DGP-specific simulated null cutoff: a diagnostic, not an implementable real-data correction. Display two-sample Monte Carlo bands, which include cutoff uncertainty.
interpretation.oracle: OLS with intercept on unobserved population-unit latent scores; exact t critical value. This oracle knows the latent units.
interpretation.fisher: Asymptotic efficient Gaussian Wald benchmark for a freely estimated congeneric 40-parameter covariance model; not a universal or finite-sample power ceiling.
interpretation.bootstrap: Implementable row-resampling contrast intervals refit all measurement and structural parameters. Only unused fit-index diagnostics are omitted within resamples; paired-seed equivalence is tested.
interpretation.scope: Five normal latent variables, four correlated predictors (rho=.35), three independent-error reflective indicators per factor. No workplace observations, missingness, nonnormality, cross-loadings or correlated errors.
interpretation.intervals: Pointwise 95% Monte Carlo intervals. Wilson intervals for rates; two-sample resampling intervals for calibrated diagnostic rates. No simultaneous coverage claim.
